items.title: Eddie Miller and Pete Fountain Interview, 1970-01-09

ctx.x: That brings up a question. I wonder, do white and black musicians, do they have much influence on each other? Does it cross the racial lines as far as musical influence is concerned?
I think they do, because I used to sit in with George Lewis when I was a kid, and this goes back, well, I'm Jack Benny's age now. I'm 39. I'll stay this year for a couple years. I mean, this day.
He had a tremendous talent, didn't he?
